result.title: Accord: Universal Online Metric Localization and Dense Mapping from one Camera and an IMU
result.summary: Dense metric mapping from a single camera and IMU remains challenging: visual-inertial odometry (VIO) provides metric motion but sparse geometry, whereas feed-forward depth models predict dense structure without ensuring metric scale. We present Accord, which constructs an accurate online dense metric map from any camera with an IMU. A VIO filter publishes metric poses, a depth foundation model conditioned on them predicts depth for short keyframe windows, and a factor graph fuses the resulting submaps. Recent work has explored several approaches to this problem. What is essential is the multi-view agreement (Accord), which is considered in SLAM as a source of geometric self-consistency. Accord anchors each keyframe window to metric 3D points triangulated from the filter poses, then exploits bidirectional dense depth agreement between co-visible images to estimate and correct per-image scale errors while preserving the metric scale established by the anchors. Context keyframes further improve depth prediction, and the resulting submaps are fused in a factor graph. We evaluate a single mapping configuration across five public camera-IMU setups and a new Phone-rig/GoPro dataset. With nothing tuned per dataset/setup and every map aligned only by Accord's own trajectory, Accord achieves consistently best/second-best mean F-score at 5 cm on every platform. Accord is open-source along with the phone-rig dataset for the benefit of the research community

AI.brief_summary: Accord 面向单目相机加 IMU 的在线稠密 metric 建图：用 VIO 位姿锚定关键帧窗口并三角化 metric 三维点，借助共视图像间的双向稠密深度一致性估计和校正每图尺度误差，再以因子图融合子图。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「多视图一致性用于校正单视图尺度误差」可能为 LVR 中跨视角视觉证据筛选、latent 状态的几何自一致性校正提供类比线索，但任务目标与表示形式差异较大，需核查其一致性信号是否可迁移。
